Publish.LongDescription:
AgX is tonemapper from Blender compared to ACES(vanilla) will have more graceful and clean rolloff to white.
### Quick Start & Usage: 1. Load your save game and open the Lumina menu and go to the *first tab*. 2. Tick **ENABLE LUMINA VOLUME** else nothing will apply either preset or LUT. 3. Scroll down and click **Import preset > Import File > type **AgX** > Click Import > Back > Close** 4. Navigate to the "Tonemapping" tab (sun inside a square) 5. Set the **Tonemapping Mode** to **External** 6. Choose **LUT Texture** from the list e.g. **AgX - High Contrast** 7. Ensure LUT Contribution is set to **1** else it will be clipping. Use adjustments instead to fine-tune later. 9. Click **Load LUT**
When you customize preset further, save it as a *new* preset with different name. Loading a Lumina preset does NOT automatically load or apply the custom LUT file, loading preset changes Lumina's settings and sliders only.
### Extra Notes: - LUTs were cooked with configuration matching what game feeds and expects from external LUTs - Overall Post Exposure set to 0.5 to 0.85 is where I would set it. - Change everything to your liking from the base preset - Screenshots were taken with AgX preset. - **Latitude Longitude:** Preset sets it to the equator but if you were not using lumina to control it, but Time & Weather anarchy there is no effect afaik. - **SSGI:** preset will not force it. - **SSAO:** preset will turn it on, and only options to control it further are inside Lumina. - **Contact Shadows:** presets will turn them off, I do not recommend them, only way to set them correctly without artefacts renders them redundant with SSAO. - **Road Textures:** Presets will turn them on, and change the settings, work well with default Lumina texture replacement.
### LUT List: - **AgX - Base Contrast** - **AgX - Greyscale** - **AgX - High Contrast** - **AgX - Low Contrast** - **AgX - Medium High Contrast** - **AgX - Medium Low Contrast** - **AgX - Punchy** - **AgX - Very Low Contrast** - **AgX - Very High Contrast**
